text:
sophia: Heads up — planning to cut release/1.13 tomorrow 16:00 PT. Need quick sanity check on backports, version bump, and changelog. Please drop any cherry-pick PR numbers and owners by EOD today.

james: ack — I have one cherrypick: #4821 (fix kv-cache eviction edgecase). Can own it.

mei: pinging on the version bump: do we want 1.13.0 or 1.13.0-rc1 for the tag? I can update CHANGELOG.md after branch is created.

sophia: go with 1.13.0 unless we get last-minute regressions. mei — assign changelog to yourself, thx.

andrew: quick question on backport policy: are breaking API changes eligible for backport? there's a small API rename in #4799.

lucy: not for minor releases — only bug fixes, perf, and non-breaking doc updates. Breaking API renames must wait for major or opt-in via feature flags.

james: added label `backport-request` to #4821 and put a short note with the cherry-pick command.

sophia: nice — use this snippet when creating the release branch:

```
git checkout -b release/1.13 origin/main
# run ./scripts/update-version.sh 1.13.0
```

mei: will run preflight CI on the branch and push changelog update. ETA 10:30 PT.

devops-bot: CI plan scheduled: preflight suites (unit, integration, perf-smoke) -> est 45m on release/1.13 after branch push.

andrew: I can review the backport PR tonight if someone opens it. Prefer small diffs.

lucy: reminder: for any backport PR, include the original PR number in the title and add `backport-owner: <name>` in the description. Helps automation.

sophia: thanks. If no blockers by 15:00 PT I'll create the branch and ping this thread with the branch commit sha.

james: picking up #4821 now.

mei: changelog drafted, will link PR in this thread once created.

sophia: perfect. small ask — if you add a backport request and then realize you missed tests, please comment and mark `needs-rebase` so we don't accidentally merge.

lucy: noted :thumbsup:

devops-bot: Reminder: cutoff for feature PRs is 2025-11-07T23:00:00Z. After that only critical fixes/backports accepted.

sophia: editing to add: if you need a backport but don't have bandwidth, flag `backport-help` and we'll triage and assign.

andrew: thanks — design team might need one more doc tweak, I'll coordinate.

sophia: great. I'll post branch link shortly if all clear.
